To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) a dashboard approach for structural design is a promising tool to enhance the decision-making process in the design phase; 2) the proposed dashboard approach is applicable to different design problems, and can be used for both preliminary and detailed design; and 3) the dashboard can be used for different structural design disciplines.

a) a dashboard approach can be used for comparing different structural design proposals; b) the dashboard approach can be applied to different structural types and different design stages; and c) a dashboard can be used as an aid for the decision making in the early stages of the structural design process.
